findings.bounded: Only current viewport dictionary; old rows retained only lookup/swap/draw scope, no global/document LRU
findings.imageOwnership: Created CGImage is owned by SumiFocusTile and released in dealloc; row/cache hold tile strongly without backreferences
findings.key: Nonretained original paragraph source identity+native characterRange+immutable visible attributed slice+metrics+scale+padding/height
findings.sourceLifetime: During lookup current old rows keep old native line/source alive and new rows keep new source alive; pointer identity is never an unowned persistent key across an LRU
findings.mutableParagraphValues: Paragraph-style values copied immutable within bounded line key
findings.contextShaping: Source identity and native range prevent equal visible text from sharing glyphs across different shaping contexts; parent input agent separately observed NSConcreteAttributedString immutable source replacement on out-of-slice canonical edit
findings.failure: Any tile allocation/key failure aborts the whole focus frame and restores native editor; no silently omitted row or stale text fallback
findings.opacity: Save original native-scroll opacity on actual first hide; restore exactly only if that focus view owns the hide; no view means no layer mutation
findings.paint: Retains one row batch and draws immutable CGImage only; selection highlight geometry reads native line mapping, no text/selection/revision/IME writes
findings.releaseInstrumentation: No candidate A/B switches, debug paths or performance globals in formal source
